about.heading: About Me
about.p1: Technology Advisor and Change Agent with expertise in Cloud Computing, Data Architecture, and AI. Trusted by governments, enterprises, and nonprofits to lead digital transformation. Microsoft Certified Trainer (MCT) and strategic leader in Azure, networking, and security.
about.p2: Beyond my technical work, I'm deeply committed to community building and education — leading HOLA Academy, delivering technical courses to NGOs in Costa Rica, and empowering Hispanic and Latinx communities in tech.
